fusions.name: Hook and Line
fusions.desc: Casts a hooked line that deals 12 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and reels you up to 7 tiles to the target. The target moves 30% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: On the Stringer
fusions.desc: Lashes out, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Dragnet
fusions.desc: Sets a dragnet 5 tiles across ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Leashed Pike
fusions.desc: A bonded pike on a chain fights beside you, striking an enemy within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it strikes moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.
